back_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
Arise and go down to the potter's house, and there I will let you hear my words.
So I went down to the potter's house, and behold, he was working at the wheel.
But the vessel that he was shaping from the clay was spoiled in the potter's hand; so he reshaped it into another vessel, as it seemed right to the potter to do.
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter does? declares the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Israel.
At one moment I may announce concerning a nation or kingdom that it will be uprooted, torn down, and destroyed.
But if that nation turns from the evil for which I denounced it, then I will relent of the disaster I had planned to do to it.
And at another moment I may announce concerning a nation or kingdom that it will be built up and planted.
But if it does evil in my sight, not listening to my voice, then I will relent of the good I had intended to do for it.

Now therefore, say to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem: Thus says the LORD: 'Behold, I am shaping a disaster against you and devising a plan against you. Turn now, each of you, from his evil way, and amend your ways and your deeds.'
But they will say, 'It is hopeless. For we will follow our own plans, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.'
Therefore thus says the LORD: Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard such things? Virgin Israel has done a most horrible thing.
Does the snow of Lebanon leave the rocky crags of the highland? Or do the cold waters flowing from afar run dry?
But my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways, the ancient roads, to walk in bypaths, a road not built up,
making their land a horror, a perpetual object of scorn; all who pass by it will be appalled and shake their heads.
Like the east wind I will scatter them before the enemy; I will show them my back and not my face in the day of their calamity.

Then they said, 'Come, let us devise plots against Jeremiah, for the law will not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor word from the prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not heed any of his words.'
Give heed to me, O LORD, and hear the voice of my accusers.
Should evil be repaid for good? Yet they have dug a pit for my life. Remember how I stood before you to speak good on their behalf, to turn your wrath away from them.

Therefore hand their children over to famine, and give them over to the power of the sword; let their wives become childless and widowed, their husbands be slain by disease, their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring a raiding band against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.

But You, O LORD, know all their plots against me to kill me. Do not wipe out their iniquity or blot out their sin from your sight; let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.
